overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long UMAC ETF (UMAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Unusual Machines, Inc. (NYSE American: UMAC), less fees and expenses, through derivatives such as options and swap agreements. UMAL was launched on Jun 17, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
